selection_process: Physical Test Level-I: Running Test (qualifying) Physical Test Level-II: Long Jump (qualifying) Physical Test Level-III: Weight Carrying Test (for final selection and merit) Verification of certificates/testimonials Character and antecedents verification Medical examination from the appropriate authority

exam_pattern.details: The notice describes only a Physical Test in three levels. Before Levels I, II and III, every candidate must furnish an undertaking (Annexure-1, in the format prescribed by the District Nodal Officer) that he/she is physically fit and mentally sound. | The Running Test is qualifying in nature. | The Long Jump is qualifying in nature and must be cleared within three attempts. | Level-III is meant for final selection of candidates. A particular time is fixed after the weight carrying test so that the stipulated number of candidates (exact number of vacancies notified plus 10% of vacancies notified) covers the distance within that time; the merit list is prepared on that basis. The merit list is prepared for the exact number of notified vacancies, with a wait list limited to a maximum of 10% of the notified vacancies. Ties are resolved first by date of birth (the older candidate gets preference), then by alphabetical order of the first name.

how_to_apply: Visit the A&N Administration recruitment portal https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in between 26 November 2026 (1100 Hrs) and 26 December 2026 (2359 Hrs).
Register your full particulars online and fill in all mandatory details; incomplete applications will not be accepted by the website.
Write your Name, Date of Birth, Father's Name and Mother's Name strictly as given in the Matriculation Certificate.
If you are registered with the local Employment Exchange as unemployed, enter your registration number in the appropriate box.
Upload a photograph in 8 bit JPEG format, between 10 Kb and 50 Kb, with resolution 100x200 pixels (recent, coloured, light or preferably white background, no red-eye, eyes visible with glasses).
Enable JavaScript in the browser (Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, etc.) to upload the application successfully.
Pay the Rs 100 fee online by 26 December 2026 (2359 Hrs), unless exempted, and make sure the payment is successful.
Take a printout of the submitted application; it can also be downloaded later.
Shortlisted candidates must bring the printed online application, originals for verification and the following self-attested copies:
One copy of recent passport size photograph
Essential Qualification Certificate and higher qualification, if any, issued by the competent authority (provisional certificates not entertained)
X Pass Certificate issued by CBSE or any other recognized Board indicating the date of birth (provisional certificates not entertained)
OBC/ST Certificate issued by a competent Revenue Authority within the jurisdiction of A&N Administration
Certificate from the Competent Authority for Meritorious Sports Persons
Employment Registration Certificate/Card issued by the Competent Authority under A & N Administration showing the registration number
Candidates who fail to complete document verification in person at the prescribed venue on the scheduled date and time will be struck off from the panel.
important_instructions: All applicants submitting before the closing date get Roll numbers; Admit Cards will be on https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in around 2 weeks before the Level-1 test and must be downloaded by the candidate. A candidate who does not find his/her name in the uploaded list must immediately email the Nodal Officer (DFO, ND) at [email protected] with proof of online application, or lose any later claim. Carry one original photo identity proof (Driving License, Aadhaar Card, Voter Card, College/University ID Card or Income Tax PAN) and the downloaded Admit Card; otherwise entry will be refused. The Physical Test venue, time and date will be given on the web portal, in local newspapers and by SMS; candidates may appear only at the centre in their Admit Card. Possession of mobile phones, accessories or other electronic gadgets inside the Physical Test premises, whether in use or switched off, is malpractice; candidature may be cancelled for up to 3 years. Applications are not scrutinised in detail before the Physical Test; candidature is provisional and can be cancelled at any stage if a claim is not substantiated. The Department may cancel the vacancy notice at any time without assigning reasons; disputes fall under courts/tribunals having jurisdiction over the A & N Islands only. Helpdesk: email [email protected], telephone 03192-264243 & 943483174 (10.00 AM to 5.00 PM, Monday to Friday); helpline 9434283174 for filling the form. The final result will be published on https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in and https://forest.and.nic.in/index.php.

content_sections.heading: About DFO Nicobar
content_sections.text: The Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Nicobar Division is located at Campbell Bay and works under the Department of Environment & Forests of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration. The notice is signed by the DFO (Nicobar Division), who also acts as the Nodal Officer for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: DFO Nicobar Mazdoor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 64 Mazdoor vacancies in one division. The number of vacancies is subject to variation. The 3 MSP posts are horizontal reservation and fall within the 64 posts. The Hindi version of the notice also shows an Ex-Servicemen column with 00 posts. ST reservation applies to those ST as specified in the constitutional order No. 1959 of A & N Islands (Scheduled Tribes). OBC reservation applies to those OBCs specified in Administration circular No. 8-3/2003-TW dated 30th March, 2006. EWS reservation applies as per the guidelines/instructions issued by the Govt. of India / A & N Administration from time to time.

content_sections.heading: DFO Nicobar Mazdoor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicant must be an Indian Citizen. Should qualify in the Physical test and must have good physique (both listed as essential). All candidates must apply online, whether or not they are registered with the Employment Exchange. Departmental candidates must also apply online; their "No objection Certificate" issued by the Head of the Department must be produced at the time of verification of original certificates/documents. Candidates seeking reserved vacancies or age relaxation must produce original certificates issued by the competent authority and a self-attested copy when sought; otherwise their ST/OBC/EWS/MSP claim will not be entertained and they will be considered under General (UR) category. OBC candidates must produce an OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate based on income for FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, issued on/after 01/04/2026 but not later than 26/12/2026. EWS candidates must meet the Central Government criteria and hold an Income & Assets certificate based on FY 2025-26 income, issued on/after 01/04/2026 but not later than 26/12/2026. Candidates who fraudulently claim ST/OBC/EWS/MSP status will be permanently debarred from the recruitment examination conducted by the Department of Environment & Forests, A&N Administration. Candidates should check the official notification for the full wording of the eligibility conditions for the Mazdoor post.

content_sections.text: The age limit as per the Recruitment Rules is 18-33 years for male and 18-38 years for female candidates, as on the closing date of receipt of online application, 26.12.2026. Age is determined only from the date of birth in the 10th pass Certificate or Birth Certificate; no other document is accepted. Central Government servants/civilian employees and departmental candidates of A&N Administration claiming relaxation must hold a certificate from their office showing continuous service of not less than three years in the period immediately preceding the closing date, and must keep that status till appointment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in DFO Nicobar Mazdoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 64 Mazdoor vacancies: UR 12, ST 07, OBC (NCL) 39 and EWS 6, with 3 posts for Meritorious Sports Persons. The number is subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. When does the DFO Nicobar Mazdoor online application start?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 26 November 2026 at 1100 Hrs on erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DFO Nicobar Mazdoor posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and fee payment is 26 December 2026, till 2359 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for DFO Nicobar Mazdoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 100, paid online. Women candidates and ST candidates eligible for reservation are exempted, and the fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the DFO Nicobar Mazdoor post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-33 years for male and 18-38 years for female candidates as on 26.12.2026, with relaxation of 5 years for ST and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for DFO Nicobar Mazdoor?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Secondary School Examination (X Std.) from a recognized Board/Institution, qualify in the Physical test and have good physique. Knowledge of Hindi is desirable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a DFO Nicobar Mazdoor?
faq.answer: The Mazdoor post is in Pay Matrix Level-1 (Rs.18000-56900).

faq.question: Q8. How are DFO Nicobar Mazdoor candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a three-level Physical Test (Running Test, Long Jump, Weight Carrying Test), followed by verification of certificates, character and antecedents, and medical examination.

faq.question: Q9. What is the running distance in the DFO Nicobar Mazdoor Physical Test?
faq.answer: Male candidates must run 10 kms and female candidates 8 kms, each within 60 minutes, in the qualifying Level-I test.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a probation period for the DFO Nicobar Mazdoor post?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a probation period of 2 years, which may be extended if performance is not found satisfactory by the Competent Authority.
